name: InvenTree
description: Open-source inventory management for parts, stock, suppliers, and BOMs, with a web UI and REST API. Installs the official InvenTree apt package on Debian 13 (nginx, port 80).

notes.text: Admin password is generated at install, shown once, and saved to /etc/inventree/credentials.txt (0600); a package-generated fallback is /etc/inventree/admin_password.txt.
Web UI: http://<container-ip> (nginx 80 to gunicorn on localhost:6000). Site URL defaults to the container IP; set var_site_url or use `inventree config:set`. Nginx is HTTP only.
Requires Debian 13 (trixie); upstream supports Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 only, so there is no Alpine path. var_version below 13 aborts.
Data: SQLite at /opt/inventree/data/database.sqlite3; media, static, and backups under /opt/inventree/data. For PostgreSQL, set INVENTREE_DB_* before a fresh install.
Services: inventree-web, inventree-worker, nginx. Use `inventree logs` and `inventree restart`. Update: `update` in the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`.
